body:
| Attr | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | `proposed` | `proposed` / `accepted` / `rejected` / `deprecated` / `superseded`. |
| `id` | — | Short identifier — rendered as a mono code chip (e.g. `ADR-007`). |
| `date` | — | ISO date string. Displayed as tabular-nums. No parsing — just shown as-is. |
| `title` | — | Decision title — rendered as H3 below the header. |
| `supersedes` | — | ADR id this replaces — shown on the right side of the header. |
| `superseded-by` / `supersededBy` | — | ADR id that replaces this one. |
